_what: The fixed prompt set of tools/quality-probe.py. Versioned here so a run taken today and a run taken after a quant change ask the SAME questions.
_why_fixed: The probe is reference-free: it compares two engines to each other, never an answer to a gold answer. That only works while the questions do not move. A prompt edited between two runs makes the two runs incomparable, so this file is evidence and changes with a version bump, never silently.
_why_these: robin's symptom is German misspelling and dialect-like non-words that grow with answer length ('Erschd kuck ich mir alles an', 'Kunstgewerkds', 'Jahrundert'), and a hex code that comes back one digit wrong. The set is built around exactly that: four long German prose tasks that force 800 to 1200 words of continuous specialist text with no list to hide in, two English ones as the language control, two tasks that must repeat literals given in the prompt, two that must return strict JSON, and two short German plans that are the agentic shape without tools.
